title: The handbook of news analytics in finance
abstract: Preface. Acknowledgements. About the editors. About the contributors. So, how does one increase the signal-to-noise ratio, ensuring protection from unforeseen exposures without an excessive number of halts or items to review? Sounds logical, right?
